AI Compare · Browser Extension

Ask once, compare answers from multiple AI tools.

AI Compare brings ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, Doubao and other AI tools into one workflow. Type a prompt once, view answers side by side, and quickly decide which response is more complete, grounded, or worth following up on.

Core Features

Turn scattered AI websites into one comparison workspace

AI Compare is not another chatbot. It keeps the AI tools and accounts you already use, then makes prompting, comparing and returning to useful sessions faster.

01 · Multi-AI view

Compare several answers in one browser tab

Select your favorite AI sites, enter one prompt, and open a side-by-side comparison page for research, writing, translation, coding and planning.

02 · Quick entry

Ask from selected text or search pages

Highlight text on any webpage, or start from Google, Baidu or Bing, then send the current question into your AI comparison flow.

03 · History and favorites

Return to questions that matter

Keep useful prompts, sessions and comparison entry points so research threads and team discussions do not disappear into browser tabs.

Use Cases

For anyone who needs to judge AI answer quality

A single AI answer can sound confident while still missing context. Side-by-side comparison makes the differences visible.

Learning and research

Compare explanations of the same concept

Use several AI tools to explain a topic, then compare examples, structure and precision before going deeper.

Writing and content

Find angles, gaps and better wording

Compare outlines, titles, summaries and rewrites without being trapped by one model's first phrasing.

Product and operations

Speed up market and user-problem analysis

Ask several AI tools about the same product question and compare how they frame pain points, competitors and next steps.

Development

Cross-check debugging and design ideas

Let multiple AI tools inspect the same error, API or design question so one confident but wrong answer is easier to catch.

Cross-language work

Calibrate translations and tone

Compare emails, product copy and customer replies across AI tools to improve accuracy, tone and localization.

SEO and GEO

Check whether AI understands your content

Ask brand or product questions across AI tools and see whether your positioning, pages and key claims are understood correctly.

3 Steps

Make AI comparison part of your everyday workflow

You do not need to replace your current AI habits. Start with one common question and put several answers on the same screen.

Choose the AI sites you use most

Create different sets for writing, coding, research, translation or search-heavy tasks.

Ask once and open the comparison page

AI Compare carries the prompt into a side-by-side page where you can switch between 1, 2, 3 or 4 columns.

Save, favorite or share useful results

Turn strong comparison sessions into reusable research material, decision notes or team discussion context.

Why compare

The value of AI is not only getting an answer. It is seeing how answers differ, then making a better judgment.
